content.value_statement: Bugs are hard to fix when evidence, scope, and hypotheses are unclear. This skill gives structured debugging workflows, checklists, and tool guidance for faster root cause analysis.
actual_capabilities: Guides issue reproduction, information gathering, hypothesis testing, and verification.
Provides debugging checklists for symptoms, environments, recent changes, and scope.
Suggests tool workflows for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and Go debugging.
Covers binary search debugging, differential comparison, tracing, and memory leak checks.
Supports performance and production bug investigations with safety-focused steps.
limitations: Does not automatically run debuggers, profilers, or monitoring tools.
Requires observable symptoms, logs, traces, or a reproducible scenario.
Examples are instructional and must be adapted to the target codebase.
Does not replace incident response policy or language-specific documentation.

use_cases.title: Triage a New Bug Report
use_cases.description: Turn vague symptoms into reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, and first hypotheses.

use_cases.title: Investigate a Performance Regression
use_cases.description: Create a profiling plan, identify likely bottlenecks, and define metrics for before-and-after verification.

use_cases.title: Analyze a Production Incident
use_cases.description: Gather logs, reports, and monitoring signals while planning safe experiments outside production.

prompt_templates.title: Reproduce a Bug
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for clarifying a bug report.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me reproduce this bug systematically. Ask for missing symptoms, environment details, exact steps, expected behavior, and actual behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Hypothesis Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow for turning evidence into experiments.
prompt_templates.prompt: Given these logs and symptoms, propose likely causes. Rank them by evidence, then design one controlled experiment for each cause.

prompt_templates.title: Debug a Performance Regression
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for profiling and measurement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this performance issue using the playbook. Create a profiling plan, identify likely bottlenecks, and define before-and-after measurements.

prompt_templates.title: Guide a Production Incident Investigation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for safe live-system analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me investigate this production bug safely. Build a timeline, evidence checklist, rollback criteria, staging test plan, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: Intermittent login failures with no obvious pattern.
output: Reproduction matrix covering browser, user role, time, and network state.
Hypotheses ranked by recent changes and external dependencies.
Next experiment that changes one condition at a time.

output_examples.input: API response time increased after a release.
output: Profiling plan for request path, database calls, and synchronous work.
Baseline metrics to collect before changing code.
Verification checklist for staging and production monitoring.

output_examples.input: Crash stack trace points to a null value.
output_examples.output: The skill would summarize the trace, identify the first application frame, list likely data sources, and propose targeted logging.

best_practices: Capture exact reproduction steps before changing code.
Change one variable per experiment and record the result.
Verify the fix with the original failing case and a regression test.
anti_patterns: Changing several parts of the system before proving a cause.
Adding broad production logging without privacy and performance review.
Ignoring stack traces, recent changes, or environment differences.

faq.question: What problems does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps investigate bugs, crashes, performance regressions, intermittent failures, and production issues.

faq.question: Does it run debugging tools automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflows, checklists, and tool guidance for the user or agent to apply.

faq.question: Which languages are covered?
faq.answer: The playbook includes examples for JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and Go.

faq.question: Can it help with production incidents?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes evidence gathering, safe investigation, staging validation, and rollback criteria.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide symptoms, expected behavior, actual behavior, logs, recent changes, environment details, and reproduction steps.

faq.question: Is it useful for performance issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides profiling, bottleneck identification, measurement, and verification after changes.
